Frequently Asked Questions

Is my photo uploaded to any server?▾

No. All images are processed locally in your browser using the Canvas API. Your photos and signatures never leave your device.

Which exams are supported?▾

We support major Indian government forms including PAN, Passport, Aadhaar, UPSC, SSC, IBPS, NEET, JEE, GATE and more. You can also customize dimensions for any other exam.

Does resizing reduce image quality?▾

We use a binary-search compression algorithm to hit the exact KB range required, while keeping the highest possible visual quality.

What file formats are supported?▾

JPG, PNG and WEBP up to 15 MB. Output is always in the format required by the exam (usually JPG).

Is the tool free?▾

Yes. Resizing and clean image downloads are free. No signup or payment is required.

Can I use it on my phone?▾

Yes — fully responsive and works on Android and iOS. Take a photo and convert it instantly.
